summary: runProcess timeout could strand a stage as 'running' forever: 'close' waits for pipe EOF, but the kill only hit the direct child - on POSIX the codex npm shim's native grandchild survives SIGKILL to the launcher and holds the inherited pipes open
repro_command: POSIX replica: kill(SIGKILL) on the node launcher at timeout; promise still pending 5s later, resolves only when the orphaned grandchild exits on its own (verifier repro on the MacBook, node 24.3.0)
prevention_layer: POSIX: detached spawn + process-group SIGKILL reaches grandchildren; all platforms: 5s grace force-finish after killTree (settled-guarded, unref'd)
